rationale: C22 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child’s treatment of an official flag. Both directives prescribe the flag’s design and proportions through textual specifications supplemented by attached illustrations or specifications expressly incorporated into the order, and both conclude by revoking an earlier directive governing the flag. C15 and C20 share statehood or flag subject matter, but not comparable operative machinery or distinctive drafting structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such further proportions as are set forth on the attachment hereto. That attachment is hereby made a part of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Coat of Arms, Seal, and Color and Flag shall be as described herein and as set forth in the illustrations and specifications which accompany this order and which are hereby made a part thereof.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive incorporation of accompanying flag illustrations and specifications into the legal directive.

shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Color and Flag of the Vice President of the United States shall consist of a white rectangular background of sizes and proportions to conform to military and naval custom
shared_material.explanation: Both establish an official flag design through detailed proportions and specifications.

shared_material.child_excerpt: SEC. 7. Revocation. [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of May 29, 1916, is hereby revoked.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of February 7, 1936, prescribing the official flag of the Vice President of the United States, is hereby revoked.
shared_material.explanation: Parallel concluding revocation of the prior directive prescribing the relevant official flag.
